lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ugh... Let's take a rest.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's tough trying to get back into the swing of things.
*Clunk*

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Is it going well?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: More or less, yeah.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Here, have this.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Oh, soda! Thanks!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I brought some snacks too, so you can have them whenever you get a little hungry.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thanks again.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Is there anything else that you need?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Nah, I'm good. Just letting me borrow your practice room is more than enough, really. I'm super grateful.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I was a little surprised when you asked to borrow my practice room out of the blue.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Heh, sorry about that...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Don't be. I'm not using it right now anyway, so it's all yours.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: By the way, this practice room is amazing. Not a single bit of clutter or distraction.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's set up to totally minimize outside distractions so you can focus just on practicing.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Those mirrors on the wall double as screens, right? So you can review your performance right away?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Wow, you noticed that!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Of course. When you're always stuck in chaotic practice rooms, you naturally start noticing improvements like this.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: So you really were a pop star, Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I've been hearing that word so much lately that it barely has any meaning anymore.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, what are you up to? Are you busy?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'm working on my next album right now, so I'm relatively free.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: How's practice been going?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: To be honest... not that great. I've been away from it for too long.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: My brain remembers everything, but my body isn't moving the way I want it to. I can feel my moves don't have any power.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: In other words, I'm rusty.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Still, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: That you're giving this everything you've got.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I was gonna just skate through it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I mean, that was the plan, but then

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Neon said I was sparkling when I practiced...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So, um...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Okay, I get what you're trying to say. If you're feeling shy, you don't have to say it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It's not that, it's...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Never mind.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Hehehe, all right.
*Click*

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Yo, ladies.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I thought you had a show today?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Came right over after wrapping it up.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You should've taken a break.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You kidding? A retired pop star from the Counters practicing for her farewell concert? I wouldn't miss this for the world.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I'm just playin'. I came to check if you need anything.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm good. You guys have already done enough by letting me use your practice room.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hey, superstars get to ask for what they want.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I didn't even get an official debut, so who're you calling a superstar?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: and the Counters. That's who.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: At least in the Nikke scene, you're a total superstar and everyone knows you.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: So if there's anything you want, just say the word.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anything?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Yeah, anything. You deserve it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Uh... so then...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Could I maybe get a producer, lyricist, composer,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: choreographer, and a costume team?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Guess that was a bad joke, huh...

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'll get in touch with my team right away.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Stop right there. MY team's got this.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Says who?

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Says me. Your team is a bunch of washed-up old geezers.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Even if I'm past my prime and taking a break, my ranking's still higher than yours.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Oh, you really wanna go there? Why don't we compare who's had more number one hits?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Enough. Bring your team's portfolio.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I'll bring ours. Let's see what you've got.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: All right, you're on!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Then Anis can choose which is better herself.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Naturally.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: W-wow, is this for real?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Man, I really worked my butt off...
*Vrr*

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: What the? Who's trying to reach me when I'm busy?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: ... Hey, I got one too.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Huh? Me too.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Guess that's how it is now.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: ... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Damn it!!! Arghhhhhh!!

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Well... at least you've secured the stage, right?

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Feel free to use the practice room as much as you need. I'll keep it free for you.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Sigh... Everyone else already did what I was gonna do, so I'm not sure how else I can help you.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Should I give you money?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's okay. I appreciate the thought.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: What's going on here anyway? Boss is acting like you committed a crime or something.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If you wanna call it a crime, then a crime it is.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Whatever. If you ever need help, just hit me up.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Yeah. We'll see if there's any other way we can help.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sure thing. Thanks, guys!

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: We're gonna head out. Good luck.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Keep pushing. You've got this.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Oh, by the way,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: people've been buzzing 'bout you making a comeback.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Between that thing on the news and you showing up on that show like you were waitin' on someone, you definitely caught a lot of eyes.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I'm no expert on the pop star scene, but looks like you were pretty famous, huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yeah... you could say that. In more ways than one.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: It's nice to know you've got fans eager for your return.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: You should see what people are saying.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Forget it. I'm not interested in that kind of stuff anymore.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I don't do well with negative comments like that.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Haha. If you can't handle a little hate, then this ain't for you. But don't you know? Even haters are just fans of a different sort.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I took a quick peek, and people are saying loads of positive things about you.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Checking them out might give you some motivation if you need it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: All right, I'll check it out when I have time.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: All right, I'm really heading out this time.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: See you later.
*Clunk*
Noise and Volume leave the practice room.
Anis picks up her phone and looks at her chat with Neon.
Her message, "How's it going?", is still unread.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Man, this is starting to make me nervous...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You just focus on looking good out there.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'll figure out the rest.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I've got to trust that Neon knows what she's doing.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm sure it'll work out... not that I have much choice.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Gotta keep practicing. I've got to whip my body into shape somehow.
Anis gets up.
One hour later.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Like this, right there...!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ugh, my leg just won't lift high enough!
Anis looks at her phone lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... No, no, gotta put it out of my mind.
One hour later.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What the heck... this just isn't working.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whew...
Anis looks at her phone lying on the floor again.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: I took a quick peek, and people are saying loads of positive things about you.

lines.speaker: noise
lines.text: Checking them out might give you some motivation if you need it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: No! Absolutely not!
One hour later.
Anis looks at her phone lying on the floor.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay, fine. Just for a second. Super quick.
Anis picks up her phone and sits down against the wall.
She logs into a pop music forum
and searches: Anis, T.T. STAR, Mint, and Prika.
Around 200 posts come up.
She taps on the one with the most comments and likes.
Title: T.T. STAR's Comeback Is Imminent
Anis was just on the news the other day, and then suddenly did a live stream for like a whole day. She was clearly trying to reach out to Mint and Prika. It's all but confirmed!
ㄴ Stop pulling stuff out of nowhere.
ㄴ I wish it were true, though.
ㄴ Who even are they?
ㄴ They used to be pretty well-known in the underground scene.
ㄴ I really loved them. Mint was seriously the best.
ㄴ Prika was the GOAT! Have you seen those abs?
ㄴ You guys just don't get how charming Anis is!
ㄴ OMG, if this turns out to be real, I'll die happy!
ㄴ They were ahead of their time. If they debuted now, they'd be crushing it.
ㄴ Eh, I dunno if I'd go THAT far...
ㄴ But yeah, they'd definitely be a hit!
ㄴ LOL, aren't they a bit old for a comeback tho?
ㄴ Anis got some nerve, fr. She's the one who ruined the group in the first place, lmao.
ㄴ You can say that again.
ㄴ Is it just me, or was Anis the worst in that group?
ㄴ No way! Anis was my favorite!
ㄴ If that's true, you need to get your ears checked.
ㄴ Screw you! Anis was the best singer of them all!
Anis's eyes dart across the screen rapidly.
Her fingers move busily, scrolling the screen, tapping to the next post, scrolling again, and tapping once more.
She begins reading each and every post, every single comment.
One Punch Girl Anis LOL! (6)
Wow, if T.T. STAR actually made a comeback, I'd seriously cry! Love them so much! (34)
Is this the Anis revenge arc? No way I'm missing this, haha! (41)
Anis is killing it. Is she gonna reclaim the surface? (124)
Whose life is she going to wreck this time? (4)
T.T. STAR 101 for Dummies! (87)
50 reasons why Anis is an idiot! (3)
50 reasons why Anis is a legend! (89)
Gaze upon her and weep, people. This is what a real pop star looks like. (41)
Why T.T. STAR's comeback is bound to succeed.jpg (57)
Title: What's with T.T. STAR? LOL (1)
They were good. I'll give them that. But that was in the underground scene. Who knows if they would've made it in the mainstream?
Even if they could've, Anis blew it. I heard something nasty went down with her, but honestly? Not my problem. Point is, the team fell apart because of her.
Mint and Prika hustle like crazy after that, doing whatever they can just to stay in the spotlight. But Anis? She joins some Commando Unit, and apparently, she's doing great.
If she's so set on walking a different path, then she should've just stuck to it. Don't come back now and mess with two people who are doing just fine without you.
Or what, did the Commando Unit kick her out, and now she's crawling back 'cause she's got nowhere else to go? Yeah, wouldn't be surprised. That's so like her.
Anyway, I'm all for T.T. STAR getting back together. Just not with Anis. Mint and Prika are killing it on their own.
She can stay dead on the surface, for all I care.
ㄴ Idiot.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hrngh!
Anis runs to the bathroom.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Ugh...! Blech...!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Cough, cough!*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: *Pant pant*
Anis sits in the corner of the bathroom,
staring at her phone the whole time.
